A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.

Complete maintenance tool 
 set.

Cleaning fluid, Manual 
 puller.

Feeler gauge, Dial 
 indicator.

Vibrometer, Straight 
 edge.
Rags.

Checks discharge quantity 
 and pressure and record them.

Check the vibration level 
 of the pump set complete with the motor then, record them.

Remove the protective 
 cover of the coupling.

Check alignment between 
 motor and pump.

Shift electric motor away 
 from the coupling.

Disconnect auxiliary 
 piping for cooling and for packing water.

Screw out screw fixing 
 bracket base to base plate.

Attach carrying rope to 
 the upper arm of the lantern.

Screw out gradually all 
 screws connecting lantern and spiral, then move spiral with the help of 
 forcing off screws.

Take out carefully the 
 whole rotor from spiral box and shift it towards the motor.

Screw out plug from the 
 bottom part of the bracket and let out oil.

Screw out runner nut, 
 then remove packing rings respectively with runner nut washer (by using puller 
 remove runner and take out fit-in spring from the shaft).

Loosen packing cover by 
 unscrewing the nuts of the holding bolts in stand type packing and remove 
 the casing of the packing.

Force out the cover of 
 the spiral from the lantern with the help of two screw drivers and remove it 
 carefully.

Separate lantern from 
 bracket by unscrewing nuts.

Remove protective casing 
 from the shaft.

Pull down the coupling 
 half from the shaft with a puller and remove coupling spring from the 
 shaft.

Remove the covers of the 
 bearing brackets after unscrewing the locking nut.

Knock out the shaft to 
 the side of the free end (towards the coupling) with the help of a wooden 
 block.

Heat up the bearing of 
 the free end side and remove it from the shaft.

Shift the shaft with the 
 second bearing back to the opposite side towards the runner, then heat up the 
 bearing and remove it from the shaft.

The validity of the 
 anti-friction ball bearings.

Check all parts for any 
 worn-out and replace them by new ones.

Inspect the run-out of 
 shafts (allowance 0.03 mm).

Heat up the new bearings 
 in oil bath and insert them on the clean shaft.

Install the covers of the 
 bearings and seal them against the bracket.

Insert new GUFERO rings 
 with covers through oiled shaft.

Pay special attention to 
 the cleanliness of the packing and sealing surfaces during inserting packing.

Coat the packing before 
 each assembly with a mixture of graphite and oil.

Smear all threads with 
 grease or with MOLYKA, if it is working in aggressive environment and in pumps 
 located on open air sites.

Mounting the impeller on 
 the shaft end of the pump.

Tighten firmly runner 
 nut.

Mounting the coupling 
 half on the shaft

Mounting carefully whole 
 rotor in the spiral box and tighten it.

Connecting auxiliary 
 piping for cooling and for packing water

After completing the 
 assembly alignment the flexible coupling of the pump and the motor (allowance 
 0.05 mm).

Put the protective cover 
 of the coupling

Check the direction of 
 rotation of pump before starting the pump for the first time.

Check the quantity of oil 
 in the thrust-bearing sump.

Open the inlet for 
 cooling the oil bath of the thrust bearing.

Check whether the inlet 
 for flooding the stuffing box is open.

Check whether the inlet 
 for hydraulic sealing of the suspension is open.

Check whether the 
 delivery sluice valve is closed.

Open the delivery 
 valve gradually after the set has been started to operate at its full speed.

Check the temperature of the 
 anti-friction bearing in the bearing top which should not exceed 75C.

Check the oil level in bearing 
 top according to the mark on the oil gauge.

Check the temperature of 
 cooling water at discharge.
